decisions.candidate_question: How should organizations balance per-action human approval, automated monitoring, and hard limits for agent actions?
decisions.scope: Cross-sector, high-volume or high-consequence agent actions in the global policy context.
decisions.time_period: Source published in 2023; prospective governance recommendations.
decisions.evidence_quality: Normative recommendations and interpretation; no comparative outcome evidence.
decisions.reason: Only four statements from one intellectual source describe complementary controls under different conditions; there are not two materially distinct, independently supported positions or 12 relevant statements.
